spec.ca: frozen SG24-A3, selected 11 modules, calls 0-30, all heads, class-word W

cell_meanings.S0: fine 64 then fine 64, same head and call
cell_meanings.S1: coarse 16 mean-head first pass, bilinear upsample, fine 64 second pass
cell_meanings.S2: coarse 32 mean-head first pass, bilinear upsample, fine 64 second pass
cell_meanings.S3: 16-gated fine 64 for both passes, same head and call
cell_meanings.S4: 32-gated fine 64 for both passes, same head and call
cell_meanings.S5: ordinary fine 64 first pass, 16-gated fine second pass
cell_meanings.S6: ordinary fine 64 first pass, 32-gated fine second pass

spec.gate: mean eight coarse SA heads at same call; block-lift by natural coarse-cell correspondence to 64x64; multiply each fine head elementwise; row normalize; no extra method hyperparameter
spec.normalization: minmax each final 64x64 map, bilinear to annotation size
spec.edge_diagnostic: 64 foreground and 64 background fine-grid query/key samples per image; seeded by image ID; strong suppression ratio<0.5, near unchanged 0.9<=ratio<=1.1; GT used only after inference
spec.selection: five fixed VOC folds separately screen raw and R2 against S0; COCO frozen transfer only
spec.storage: resumable per-image counts and small mechanism/edge sidecars; no images, masks, or full attention matrices
